description: Changes the developer's projects (new apps land in «Explorer»). create, rename, set_developer_name, delete (empty, not Pro, not Explorer), move an app to another project (when its users' data must change database it first answers confirmRequired with a plan: repeat with confirm: true once the developer agrees), set_app_caps (one app's limits inside its pool), and the connections of a project or of the account: Cloudflare, own database, cloud storage, Stripe. Pro is bought per project with neblla_billing. More: neblla_get_llms tools/projects

action.description: What to do. By action: create {name}; rename {projectId, name}; set_developer_name {projectId, developerName}; delete {projectId}; move {appId, projectId, confirm?}; set_app_caps {appId, credits?, store?, files?}; cloudflare_topic {projectId?, topic, on?}; remove_cloudflare {projectId?, force?}; connect_db {projectId?, engine, config, migrate?}…

config.description: connect_db: { uri, dbName? } (mongo), { url, authToken } (turso) or { uri } (postgres, mysql).

confirm.description: move: true once the developer agreed to move the app's data.

credits.description: set_app_caps: credits a day for the app; null or 0 removes the cap.

developerName.description: set_developer_name: the name the project's apps say «by»; empty or null is the developer's own name.

engine.description: connect_db: mongo, turso, postgres or mysql.

files.description: set_app_caps: number of files; null or 0 removes the cap.

force.description: remove_cloudflare: even with media in their bucket.

fromClient.description: cloud_settings: let the users' clients save in the developer's cloud (default false).

limits.description: cloud_settings: bytes per file, per user per day and per app per day.

migrate.description: connect_db: start moving the apps' data there now.

on.description: cloudflare_topic: false turns the topic off.

projectId.description: The project, from neblla_projects_read list; left out in connection actions: the account.

store.description: set_app_caps: store bytes; null or 0 removes the cap.

topic.description: cloudflare_topic: media, domain, mail or server.

name: neblla_projects
title: Manage projects
